competency_fulfillment.rationale: The competency explicitly requires '3 to 4 numbers', but every one of the 5 samples (e.g. 'Daniel has ₱4 in bills and ₱0 in coins') combines only two numbers, never three or four.

comprehensive_coverage.rationale: Across all 5 seeds the operand count never varies from two, so the batch gives zero evidence the generator can produce the 3-4 number combinations this competency is named for.

cognitive_capacity.rationale: The individual sentence templates ('X has ₱A in bills and ₱B in coins') are clear and appropriately concrete for Grade 3 Q2.

variant_comprehensiveness.rationale: Mixing addition and subtraction across 3-4 operands (the defining feature of this competency vs. the simpler 2-number addition node) is not demonstrated anywhere in this batch.

competency_alignment.rationale: As rendered, these 5 samples are structurally identical to a plain 2-number addition/subtraction node and do not distinguish themselves as testing the '3 to 4 numbers' skill this competency specifically names.

scale_appropriateness.rationale: Individual peso values (0-13) are appropriately small 2-digit amounts, but this is secondary to the missing 3-4 number structure that defines the competency.
